generator: Codex built-in image_gen (delegated from Claude Code)
note: On-server picture library for automatic product pictures: generic, unbranded category photographs of the items a repair and accessories shop sells. Not exact manufacturer or SKU images. A few shapes resemble well-known products (e.g. detachable controllers, a VR headset, earbuds, a delivery van) but carry no logos or text.

inspection.method: seven contact sheets reviewed by eye plus the generator's own check
inspection.result: Complete subjects on white studio backgrounds; no legible text, brand marks or packaging. Standard electrical dial symbols on the multimeter are the only markings. wallet-case was regenerated once because the first version showed a banknote and a wallpaper.

styleTemplate: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: an individual fictional product catalog image for a repair shop POS dashboard. Square composition. Pure solid white #ffffff studio background, premium photoreal commercial catalog photography, softly lit, tiny realistic grounding shadow, coherent 3/4 camera angle, entire product visible with clean margins, product fills about 75% of canvas. No logos, brand marks, text, numbers, labels, watermarks, UI or packaging; generic and unbranded.
